field-disabled-fg.$description: Material 3 disabled entry ink. Kept on the M3 outline role (outline.strong) when the low-em text ink darkened.

border-block-start-width.$description: Material 3 omits the border at block start.

border-inline-width.$description: Material 3 omits the border at the inline edges.

height.$description: Material 3 medium field height before density.

padding-inline.$description: Material 3 plain field and unit padding.

font-size-touch.$description: Material 3 minimum input font size under a coarse pointer.

stepper-disabled-fg.$description: Material 3 keeps this mark on the M3 outline role (outline.strong), apart from the darker low-em text ink.
